reason: I need the flat done and I know the platform could help, but I got burned on a renovation once and I won't pay a middleman before I know what happens when a builder walks off halfway. I'd rather find a builder myself and keep the money in my control.
objection: If the work goes wrong halfway, will the platform actually help me, or just take its cut and leave me arguing with the builder?
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that my money is held and released in stages as each stage is signed off, plus the platform stepping in to finish or refund when a builder fails.
